subject.why: The travel trunk is immediately recognizable with its flat lid, leather straps, buckles, handle, and painted sunflower detail as requested.

category.why: The trunk rests on a polished wooden floor with a soft reflection against a clean, two-tone green gradient wall.

clean.why: No text, logos, UI, frames, or characters are present.

framing.why: The trunk is centrally placed with a chunky silhouette and generous breathing room on all sides.

colour.why: Bright, saturated tones with excellent separation between the red trunk, green wall, and honey-wood surface.

detail.why: Details are clean and stylized without noisy micro-textures or extraneous props.

style.why: Smooth, rounded chunky shapes with soft specular highlights and satin sheen, matching the game art style.

bg_colour.why: background is green (100% of the background); planned green
